intro: Gubber Blump is a dwarf fisherman and trainer stationed along the shores of Auberdine in Darkshore. Positioned on the sands between the docks and the flight master, he is an enthusiastic lover of the angling craft and seafood, particularly fresh crab meat.

p: While most dwarves find comfort beneath stone or beside a roaring forge, Gubber Blump prefers the misty coastline of Darkshore. Stationed along the beach at Auberdine, between the flight master and the ferry pier, Gubber teaches the art of fishing and sells basic angling gear to passing travelers. He holds a deep culinary appreciation for crab meat, though he frequently relies on adventurers to help secure his catches along the dangerous coast, as well as reclaim sentimental family fishing tackle.

Gubber is known to share candid stories about his family, notably his cousin Graun Blump, whom he insists possesses both a beard and an unusual odor. Travelers who lend a hand with his coastal errands—whether hauling in crawler legs or retrieving his family pole—often earn a thoughtful handwritten letter of thanks from Gubber, usually accompanied by a shiny fishing lure to encourage their future casts.
